body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Move up to 1 unit into cover. Gain +1 Fortitude against ranged attacks until the start of your next turn, even if no cover is available.

surges.html: One adjacent willing ally gains the Fortitude bonus.

rider.title: Lock - Suppression
rider.html: After resolving, choose a visible creature within ranged Weapon Range. You may burn 1 die to establish Lock on it without leaving cover.
